verdict.rationale: Docs show you can list regions available to a database and its configured read-only regions, implying some region selection capability, and PlanetScale Managed (bring-your-own-cloud) suggests customers can control where their data physically resides. However there is no explicit documentation of choosing a primary region at database creation or formal data-residency/compliance guarantees. missing for 10: explicit region-selection-at-creation docs, data residency/compliance certifications, and independent confirmation of region control in practice.
